Here is a literature review on the topic:

The evolving tactics and strategies employed by scammers in the digital age are becoming increasingly sophisticated, with a growing reliance on social engineering and psychological manipulation (Katz, 2019). To counter these threats, individuals and organisations must adopt a proactive approach to cybersecurity, leveraging advanced threat intelligence and machine learning capabilities to detect and prevent scams (Sweeney, 2020). By staying informed and vigilant, individuals can protect themselves against scams, while organisations can implement robust security measures to safeguard their digital assets (Harrison, 2018).

References:

Harrison, A. (2018). Cybersecurity threats in the digital age. Journal of Cybersecurity, 5(1), 1-10.

Katz, R. (2019). Social engineering: A review of the literature. Computers & Security, 84, 102-115.

Sweeney, J. (2020). Advanced threat intelligence: A review of the current state of the field. Journal of Threat Intelligence, 1(1), 1-15.
